newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET - Atherton sends NZ selection in to bat.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET - Atherton sends NZ selection in to bat.

text.p: PALMERSTON NORTH, Jan 13 - England captain Mike Atherton won the toss and sent the New Zealand Selection in to bat in their four-day cricket match starting at Fitzherbert Park on Monday, NZPA reports.
Auckland fast-medium bowler Chris Brown was left out of the New Zealand Selection.
The pitch has a good covering of grass on it and should have plenty of pace and bounce.
However the match will have a late start, as it began to rain shortly after the toss was made.
Ground staff rushed out to get the covers in place. The prospects are for occasional showers during the day interspersed with fine days.
England: Mike Atherton (captain), Nick Knight, Alec Stewart, Nasser Hussain, Graham Thorpe, John Crawley, Craig White, Dominic Cork, Andrew Caddick, Chris Silverwood, Phil Tufnell.
New Zealand Selection: Mark Greatbatch (captain), Blair Pocock, Craig Spearman, Adam Parore, Llorne Howell, Matt Horne, Justin Vaughan, Mark Haslam, Paul Wiseman, Danny Morrison, Robert Kennedy.
